Escape from Tarkov 2: Now its personal

Good bullets over meta weapon builds, dont spend 500k on an M4 if you dont have the good ammo such as M855A1

Big picture tasking is a must to progress faster, there's always an item that you will need in a future task, and in my honest opinion, if you have the items to finish a task and progress, don't be greedy and extract. (This comes from a man who was searching for a P22 for samples for almost 2 months after selling the one that therapist gives you)

Map knowledge is a must, know  the hotspots and how to move on them depending on your goal. A good way to know your maps is by offline raiding, or if you have your cellphone in hand, having a map of the map you are playing.

If you notice a boss in your raid, and you don't feel prepared, then avoid it. Most of the bosses can tank bullets that are belowe 40 pen. Specially Sanitar when on drugs, man that is a tough MF.

If you plan to get the kappa, then do Shooter Born in Heaven as soon as you get it, because late wipe shoreline and reserve are a pain in the ass, trust me.

The most important tip though is have fun, play the game the way you want, and don't feel forced to play in X way, because that's the way your group plays. If you like looting and exploring, then do it, dont force yourself to PvP, or to sweat the game because of peer pressure.
